final_total_order: 1. Validate both inputs, arrays, all entry objects and recognized present-field types; malformed -> invalid_input2.
2. Compute both exact selected lists; more than one entry in either -> invalid_input2, even when tags has zero.
3. No selected tags entry -> unknown2, even when the selected ps entry has an alias conflict or remote marker.
4. Selected tags/ps entry with both nonempty name/model and unequal values -> identity_conflict1.
5. Missing/empty selected tag digest or, when selected, ps digest -> unknown2, even when a valid remote marker exists.
6. Valid nonempty selected remote marker -> remote_inventory1, even when nonempty digests differ.
7. No selected ps entry -> available_not_loaded1, meaning absent exact name only in supplied capture.
8. Compare selected nonempty digests exactly: unequal -> identity_conflict1; equal -> loaded_same_digest0.
input_rules: Reject invalid JSON, duplicate JSON keys, absent files, nonobject envelopes, missing/nonarray models or nonobject entries as invalid_input exit2.
Across all entries, recognized name/model/digest/remote_model/remote_host fields if present must be strings; other types including null are invalid_input2. Unknown unrelated fields are ignored.
Selection: name == expected OR model == expected, exact case-sensitive strings. No trimming, basename, latest tag inference or digest normalization.
More than one selected entry in either array is invalid_input2 regardless digest agreement.
Selected entry whose nonempty name and nonempty model differ is identity_conflict1 before remote handling.
No tags selection is unknown2, even with ps selection. Missing or empty selected digest is unknown2. Missing selected model field is permitted if name supplies identity, and vice versa.

Absent or empty string remote markers are not remote. Any valid nonempty string remote marker on selected tags or ps is remote_inventory1, before unequal digests. Ps marker recognition is conservative inference not vendor schema.
No selected ps plus valid selected local tag digest is available_not_loaded1, meaning only absent from supplied ps capture.

Selected nonempty unequal digests are identity_conflict1; equal digests loaded_same_digest0. Neither proves current liveness, local weights or readiness. readiness always unknown and scope offline-captures-not-runtime.
Do not inspect expiry/current time/file mtime; both capture times, simultaneity and same-daemon origin unknown. File stat for regular-file safety is allowed, not timestamp evidence.
mode_rules: --help conventional plaintext exit0 is not classification. Bad classification argv produces JSON invalid_input2.

--selftest outer clean0/selftest_failed1 is mode-dependent, intentional; never infer domain classification from exit alone. Actual child CLI assertions require stable finding_id and exact exit plus readiness/scope.
Nonvacuous fixture corpus has at least16 unique case names and independent literal expected_exit/expected_finding. No network/acquisition feature.
integration: Later concrete owner discoveries may require an explicit appended ruling, not automatic acceptance of advisory proposals. Advisory high/medium labels from missing code are prospective risks, not observed vulnerabilities.
